summary: Iteration 6: Tested the shared Add Student form (AddStudentModal) for Admin and MD on the Students and Setup pages, plus the MD-only backend restrictions. Backend: 13/13 new tests passed. The 23-test iteration 5 suite also passed after one obsolete test was updated (it expected Admin to get 403 on POST /students; Admin is now allowed). UI (375x667): every flow passed. Admin add-student-btn opens add-student-form with all fields listed, the eye toggle works, Term x3 splits 30000 into 10000 x3, the student appears in the list (27 -> 28), and the new parent logs in at /auth/parent-login and lands on /parent/home. Admin Setup shows students-card and btn-add-student, has no btn-add-teacher, btn-add-admin or staff-mgmt-card, and Class Strength updates after saving. Phone 9876543210 shows 'Existing login: anjali.reddy' and hides the username/password fields. No OTP text anywhere. MD Setup btn-add-student opens the same shared form, and btn-add-teacher opens the teacher form (s-name, s-email, s-pwd, s-class, save-staff). Regression: MD Set fee plan (15000 as 3 terms) and Set login both saved, and that parent can log in. Only minor issues were found.

minor.issue: Admin can set credentials for an EXISTING parent who has no login (a legacy parent) just by adding a sibling with the same phone plus a username and password (server.py:621-631). This works around the MD-only POST /users/{id}/parent-login. Confirm this is intended.
The backend does not check that parent_phone is 10 digits (only the frontend checks). StudentIn accepts any string.
Not atomic: the parent user is created or updated with credentials before the student is inserted, so a failed insert leaves a parent login with no student.

ui_bugs.issue: Admin still sees a grey trash icon on every student. Tapping it calls Alert.alert('MD only'), which does nothing on web. Hide del-{id} for non-MD users. Reference: app/admin/students.tsx:225-234

issues: The password eye toggle is only 20x23px. hitSlop does not enlarge the tap area on web, so it is below the 44px minimum (StudentForm.tsx:60, styles.eye).
Class is free text, so typos create new classes in Class Strength (stray entries like 'S' already exist in the data). Use a picker built from the CLASSES list.

action_items: Decide whether Admin may set the login of an existing parent who has none via POST /students (sibling path). If not, return 403 for admin when the parent exists without a username.
Hide the delete (trash) icon for Admin on the Students page.
Add a 10-digit check for parent_phone in the backend StudentIn model.
Optional: replace the free-text Class input with a picker; make the eye toggle tap area at least 44px; fix '1 students' pluralization.
critical_code_review_comments: StudentForm.tsx: PlanFields useEffect re-splits the term amounts whenever the total changes, so any custom amounts the user typed are overwritten. This is acceptable but worth knowing.
Validation messages use Alert.alert, which does nothing on web (pre-existing pattern), so web users get no feedback on invalid input.
test_iteration5.py creates TEST_ students without cleaning them up; many 'TEST_xxxx Kid' records are building up in the Students list.
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/test_iteration5.py (updated the obsolete test expecting Admin 403 on POST /students to expect 200)
seed_data_creation: Seeded via Mongo one TEST legacy parent (no login) and a TEST_Legacy Kid without a fee plan for the Set login and Set fee plan UI regression. Those three test students and their parents and payments were deleted after testing. Students created by test_iteration6.py are deleted by its fixture teardown (their parents and payments remain).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Use unique usernames (uuid suffix). Modals slide in, so wait about 1s and scroll elements into view with el.scrollIntoView() before clicking, otherwise Playwright reports 'outside of viewport'. Run tests/seed_legacy_ui.py to get a parent without a login for testing Set login.
